title: semark check --json
description: What `semark check <root> --json` prints: the corpus-level findings and, per design, its diagnostics and the readiness of every screen and widget.

skipped.description: Nested copies of a corpus (folders with their own patterns.md) that were not walked.

corpus.description: Findings about the corpus as a whole, such as two folders declaring one design name.

folder.description: Corpus-relative, with /; empty for the root.

code.description: A code from spec/checks.md, such as unresolved, ambiguous, enum-value.

raw.description: The token as typed, brackets included.

things.description: Fields the screen shows, counted through their definitions, once each.

onDefaults.description: Open fields drawn on a default.

blocking.description: Open fields with no default: nothing can be drawn for them.

unknownWords.description: Words written as "?", and actions with no words.

level.description: The level the page reaches (spec/syntax.md, Levels).
